1.explanation:
• index.md & index.en-us.md document the NumberPicker API (precision, step, defaultValue).  
• demo/precision.md shows how precision prop affects display.  
• demo/step.md shows step increments behavior.  
• demo/basic.md provides the simplest setup to reproduce.  
• theme/index.jsx contains the component’s styling wrapper, useful for full context.  
Together these allow replication of the float‐precision bug and investigation of rounding logic.
1.bug_scenario: The screenshot shows a NumberPicker initialized with defaultValue=4.02 and step=0.01 (precision=2). In Safari, clicking the “+” button increments the value but displays “4.029999999999999” instead of rounding to 4.03. Key elements are the “+” button, the numeric input display, and the precision/step props.
